source.title: Some open problems in the theory of rational interpolants in the complex plane

trace.notes: Normalized the single URL source https://zbmath.org/1361279 as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with trailing identifier 1361279. Local workflow shard metadata identifies the exact work as 'Some open problems in the theory of rational interpolants in the complex plane', year 1999. WorldCat catalog metadata confirms the same chapter title and identifies the authors as A. Ambroladze and H. Wallin within 'Computational methods and function theory 1997'.

Failure modes: network_or_dns_failure for local shell fetches of zbmath.org and api.zbmath.org; metadata_only for browser/search-accessible resolver, catalog, and title-list pages. Browser opening of the exact zbMATH URL did not expose a readable record body or full-text link, and the zbMATH API root exposed only a terms-gated landing page rather than document JSON.

trace.notes: Bounded exact-work recovery used the zbMATH identifier, the exact title, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus authors, the book title plus PDF, the ISBN 9810236263, the World Scientific book URL 10.1142/3927, and candidate catalog/title-list pages. Recovered candidates were rejected because they were catalog records, table-of-contents metadata, publisher/title-list metadata, unrelated numeric matches, or different related papers such as Ambroladze-Wallin articles on rational interpolants and research-problem notes rather than a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the target chapter's problem statements.
No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the chapter's open-problem statements was recovered.

No candidates were extracted because the only accessible same-work materials were resolver metadata, catalog entries, table-of-contents listings, and search snippets. The workflow forbids extracting open problems from metadata-only sources.
